headline: 每日深读｜2026-10-06：5项值得追踪的进展
lead: 本期从过去24小时的12项合格候选中，选取5项有来源的报道，按具体进展展开。

chapters.title: Boeing locks in 7-year deal to triple PAC-3 MSE seeker output
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: The agreement follows the framework deal that was announced in April. Production will be spread over seven years, matching Lockheed Martin’s push to surge production on the PAC-3 MSE all-up round. Lockheed in January announced a seven-year framework agreement to increase annual PAC-3 interceptor production from approximately 600 to 2,000. Boeing’s PAC-3 seekers work by identifying, tracking and knocking out a range of threats, from ballistic missiles and hypersonics to hostile air platforms.

chapters.title: Germany to set up first drone regiment next year, modeled after Ukraine war lessons
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: VIENNA — Germany plans to stand up its first dedicated drone regiment next year, Defense Minister Boris Pistorius announced, as Berlin attempts to institutionalize lessons from the war in Ukraine after years of domestic foot-dragging on unmanned warfare.

chapters.title: US Marine Corps anti-ship weaponry to see exercise action on remote Japan island near Taiwan
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The U.S. Marine Corps will deploy its ground-based anti-ship and air-defense systems to Japan’s southwesternmost island for exercise Keen Sword, placing new U.S.-Japan capabilities on an island sitting just 110 kilometers from Taiwan.

displayTranslation.text: 马尼拉，菲律宾——美国海军陆战队将在“利剑”演习中，把其陆基反舰和防空系统部署到日本最西南端的岛屿，从而将新的美日能力部署到距台湾仅110公里的岛屿上。
displayTranslation.sourceText: MANILA, Philippines — The U.S. Marine Corps will deploy its ground-based anti-ship and air-defense systems to Japan’s southwesternmost island for exercise Keen Sword, placing new U.S.-Japan capabilities on an island sitting just 110 kilometers from Taiwan.

chapters.title: U.S. Navy Completes Successful Test Flight of Blackbeard Long-range Hypersonic Strike Missile
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: Blackbeard, an air-launched, long-range hypersonic strike missile, successfully completed another milestone recently, with a flight test on an F/A-18E/F Super Hornet at Naval Air Station (NAS) Patuxent River, Maryland.

displayTranslation.text: Blackbeard是一种空射远程高超声速打击导弹，最近在马里兰州帕塔克森特河海军航空站的一架F/A-18E/F“超级大黄蜂”上成功完成了一次飞行测试，从而实现了又一个里程碑。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Blackbeard, an air-launched, long-range hypersonic strike missile, successfully completed another milestone recently, with a flight test on an F/A-18E/F Super Hornet at Naval Air Station (NAS) Patuxent River, Maryland.

blocks.text: Navy press release Developed by Castelion and led by the Portfolio Acquisition Executive Aviation (PAE(A)) through its Future Capability Development and Integration (FCD&I) Aviation Rapid Capabilities Cell, in coordination with the Naval Air Warfare Centers and the DON Rapid Capabilities Office, Blackbeard will provide carrier-based strike fighters with a responsive, high-speed strike option to pierce contested anti-access/area-denial (A2/AD) envelopes while significantly expanding theater magazine depth.

displayTranslation.text: 据海军新闻稿，Blackbeard由Castelion开发，并由航空组合采购主管（PAE(A)）通过其未来能力开发与集成（FCD&I）航空快速能力小组领导，与海军航空作战中心及海军部快速能力办公室协调，将为航母舰载打击战斗机提供一种响应迅速的高速打击选项，以穿透有争议的反介入/区域拒止（A2/AD）范围，同时显著扩大战区弹药深度。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Navy press release Developed by Castelion and led by the Portfolio Acquisition Executive Aviation (PAE(A)) through its Future Capability Development and Integration (FCD&I) Aviation Rapid Capabilities Cell, in coordination with the Naval Air Warfare Centers and the DON Rapid Capabilities Office, Blackbeard will provide carrier-based strike fighters with a responsive, high-speed strike option to pierce contested anti-access/area-denial (A2/AD) envelopes while significantly expanding theater magazine depth.

blocks.text: This represents a key developmental test step in the program’s progression to Early Operational Capability (EOC).

displayTranslation.text: 这代表着该项目向早期作战能力（EOC）推进过程中的一个关键开发测试步骤。
displayTranslation.sourceText: This represents a key developmental test step in the program’s progression to Early Operational Capability (EOC).

chapters.title: First Release Of USAF’s New HACM Hypersonic Cruise Missile Has Happened Over Australian Range
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: Air Force’s scramjet-powered Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) has finally reached the flight test phase, with at least one “release” having been carried out so far over a range in Australia.

displayTranslation.text: 美国空军的超燃冲压发动机驱动的“高超声速攻击巡航导弹”（HACM）终于进入飞行测试阶段，迄今已在澳大利亚的一处试验靶场上进行了至少一次“释放”。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Air Force’s scramjet-powered Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) has finally reached the flight test phase, with at least one “release” having been carried out so far over a range in Australia.

blocks.text: Air Force, in partnership with Australia, has conducted a flight test of the Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) as part of our continuous work to advance long-range strike capabilities,” an Air Force spokesperson confirmed to TWZ today.

displayTranslation.text: 美国空军的一位发言人今天向TWZ证实，美国空军与澳大利亚合作，进行了“高超声速攻击巡航导弹”（HACM）的飞行测试，这是我们持续推进远程打击能力工作的一部分。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Air Force, in partnership with Australia, has conducted a flight test of the Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) as part of our continuous work to advance long-range strike capabilities,” an Air Force spokesperson confirmed to TWZ today.

blocks.text: “This effort is part of the Southern Cross Integrated Flight Research Experiment (SCIFiRE), a collaborative agreement built on more than 15 years of partnership between our two nations.” “Leveraging this enduring alliance, the Royal Australian Air Force executed the release of a HACM flight test unit over a designated Australian test range, gathering crucial data to advance the program’s objectives,” the spokesperson added.

displayTranslation.text: 该发言人补充说，这项工作属于“南十字综合飞行研究实验”（SCIFiRE）的一部分，这是建立在两国超过15年伙伴关系基础上的合作协议；借助这一持久联盟，澳大利亚皇家空军在指定的澳大利亚试验靶场上执行了一枚HACM飞行测试单元的释放，收集了推进项目目标的关键数据。
displayTranslation.sourceText: “This effort is part of the Southern Cross Integrated Flight Research Experiment (SCIFiRE), a collaborative agreement built on more than 15 years of partnership between our two nations.” “Leveraging this enduring alliance, the Royal Australian Air Force executed the release of a HACM flight test unit over a designated Australian test range, gathering crucial data to advance the program’s objectives,” the spokesperson added.

blocks.text: In 2023, the Air Force did release a picture , seen below, showing an air-breathing hypersonic cruise missile test article related to either HACM or the preceding HAWC effort.

displayTranslation.text: 2023年，空军确实发布了一张图片，如下所示，展示了一款与HACM或此前的HAWC工作相关的吸气式高超声速巡航导弹测试样弹。
displayTranslation.sourceText: In 2023, the Air Force did release a picture , seen below, showing an air-breathing hypersonic cruise missile test article related to either HACM or the preceding HAWC effort.

displayTranslation.title: 德国将于明年组建首个无人机团，借鉴乌克兰战争经验
displayTranslation.summary: 德国国防部长鲍里斯·皮斯托里乌斯宣布，德国计划在明年组建其首个专门的无人机团。报道发自维也纳。此举意在把乌克兰战争的经验制度化，此前柏林在无人作战领域已多年拖沓。

events.originalTitle: First Release Of USAF’s New HACM Hypersonic Cruise Missile Has Happened Over Australian Range
events.excerpt: The U.S. Air Force’s scramjet-powered Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) has finally reached the flight test phase, with at least one “release” having been carried out so far over a range in Australia. DARPA “The U.S. Air Force, in partnership with Australia, has conducted a flight test of the Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) as part of our continuous work to advance long-range strike capabilities,” an Air Force spokesperson confirmed to TWZ today.

evidenceRecords.text: Air Force’s scramjet-powered Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) has finally reached the flight test phase, with at least one “release” having been carried out so far over a range in Australia.

Air Force, in partnership with Australia, has conducted a flight test of the Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) as part of our continuous work to advance long-range strike capabilities,” an Air Force spokesperson confirmed to TWZ today.

“This effort is part of the Southern Cross Integrated Flight Research Experiment (SCIFiRE), a collaborative agreement built on more than 15 years of partnership between our two nations.” “Leveraging this enduring alliance, the Royal Australian Air Force executed the release of a HACM flight test unit over a designated Australian test range, gathering crucial data to advance the program’s objectives,” the spokesperson added.
In 2023, the Air Force did release a picture , seen below, showing an air-breathing hypersonic cruise missile test article related to either HACM or the preceding HAWC effort.

displayTranslation.title: 美国空军新型HACM高超声速巡航导弹在澳大利亚靶场上空完成首次释放
displayTranslation.summary: 美国空军的超燃冲压发动机驱动的高超声速攻击巡航导弹（HACM）已进入飞行试验阶段，迄今至少在澳大利亚一处靶场上空进行了一次“释放”。美国空军发言人向TWZ确认，美国空军与澳大利亚合作开展了HACM飞行试验，这是美方持续推进远程打击能力工作的一部分。HACM由DARPA参与。目前仅确认已实施至少一次释放，具体时间、次数与结果尚未公布。
